blocks.orig: Seeing Mount Kilimanjaro from a plane is a once-in-a-lifetime experience that allows for unparalleled views of the peaks and glaciers of this famous mountain. In a 45-minute flight, you pass over the mountain and get to see the different sides in one go. Perfect for those who are fascinated by Africa’s highest lone standing mountain, but are not able or willing to climb it!
blocks.html: A flight past Mount Kilimanjaro is a once-in-a-lifetime experience, giving you unparalleled views of the peaks and glaciers of the well-known mountain. The 45-minute flight takes you over the top, so you see its various sides in a single trip. A great choice if Africa’s highest lone standing mountain fascinates you, but climbing it is not possible or not for you!

blocks.orig: Best time to fly: from sunrise until 9 AM, and between 5 PM and sunset, when weather conditions are most stable
blocks.html: Best time to fly: between sunrise and 9 AM, and from 5 PM until sunset, when the weather is at its most stable
